UscHistoryEntry.title: UscHistoryEntry
UscHistoryEntry.description: Shared cross-browser DISCOM USC lookup history record with latest 12-month usage and billing averages.

id.description: Deterministic sanitized document identifier derived from USC number and state ID.

uscNumber.description: Normalized DISCOM Unique Service Connection (USC) number.

consumerName.description: Optional consumer label returned by DISCOM portal (non-PII display alias).

discomShortName.description: Short name of the regional DISCOM (e.g. TGSPDCL, APEPDCL).

sanctionedLoadKw.description: Optional sanctioned or contracted load in kW.

avgMonthlyUnits.description: Latest 12-billed-months average monthly electricity usage in kWh.

avgMonthlyBill.description: Latest 12-billed-months average monthly electricity bill in INR.

monthsCount.description: Total number of monthly records stored in the entry (0 to 24).

verifiedMonthsCount.description: Count of DISCOM portal-verified monthly records (0 to 24).

timestampIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp string of the latest fetch.

months.description: Optional bounded list (max 24) of monthly kWh and bill records.

visibility.description: Visibility scope enabling shared cross-browser reads.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified user who created this shared USC history entry.

InverterPlant.title: InverterPlant
InverterPlant.description: Non-secret installed solar inverter plant profile and latest synchronized telemetry snapshot.

brand.description: Inverter brand or monitoring platform ecosystem.

plantName.description: Display name of the installed solar plant (non-PII).

stationId.description: Optional monitoring portal station or plant identifier.

loggerSerial.description: Optional inverter or Wi-Fi data logger serial number.

installedCapacityKwp.description: Installed solar DC/AC array capacity in kWp (0.1 to 5000).

exportTariffInr.description: Grid export feed-in credit rate in INR/kWh (0 to 50).

meterMode.description: CT clamp / smart meter detection preference.

autoSyncMinutes.description: Automatic cloud polling interval in minutes (0, 5, 15, 30, 60).

hasSyncedData.description: Whether at least one real generation reading has been synced.

todayDateKey.description: Calendar date key (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest synced daily snapshot.

todayGenKwh.description: Synced solar generation for todayDateKey in kWh.

livePowerKw.description: Latest reported instantaneous AC output power in kW.

todayUsageKwh.description: Optional CT/smart-meter daily home consumption in kWh.

todayExportKwh.description: Optional CT/smart-meter daily grid export in kWh.

todayImportKwh.description: Optional CT/smart-meter daily grid import in kWh.

lifetimeKwh.description: Optional cumulative lifetime generation in kWh.

hasSmartMeter.description: Auto-detected flag indicating CT/smart-meter load or grid channels are present.

syncSource.description: Origin of the latest synced telemetry.

lastSyncedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of latest telemetry sync.

lastSyncedAtIst.description: Human-readable local/IST timestamp of latest telemetry sync.

statusNote.description: Optional non-secret status summary from the last sync.

visibility.description: Visibility scope enabling cross-browser viewing of plant telemetry.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified user who registered this plant.

InverterDailyLog.title: InverterDailyLog
InverterDailyLog.description: Date-keyed daily solar inverter generation and optional CT/smart-meter log entry.

dateKey.description: Calendar date key matching document ID (YYYY-MM-DD).

generationKwh.description: Actual inverter solar energy generated for the day in kWh.

consumptionKwh.description: Optional CT/smart-meter home consumption in kWh.

exportKwh.description: Optional grid export energy in kWh.

importKwh.description: Optional grid import energy in kWh.

peakPowerKw.description: Optional peak instantaneous AC power reached during the day in kW.

weatherPotentialKwh.description: Optional weather-based potential generation benchmark for comparison in kWh.

performanceRatioPct.description: Optional actual vs. potential Performance Ratio percentage.

hasSmartMeter.description: Whether CT/smart-meter channels were present on this day.

syncSource.description: Sync method that recorded this daily log.

recordedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this daily log was synced.

visibility.description: Visibility scope enabling cross-browser log reads.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the plant owner who created this daily log.

/usc_history/{entryId}.description: Shared USC lookup history collection readable across all browsers and screens, with verified-user writes and owner/admin deletion.

/inverter_plants/{plantId}.description: Solar inverter plant profiles and latest live generation snapshots, readable across browsers with verified owner/admin write control.

/inverter_plants/{plantId}/daily_logs/{d.description: Date-keyed (YYYY-MM-DD) daily solar inverter generation and optional CT/smart-meter logs protected by parent plant Master Gate ownership checks.
